Seer.directive_rationale: your first priority is to communicate your results immediately upon claiming
Seer.actual_player_behavior: Hoang claimed to be the Seer and immediately revealed that he investigated Nhan and confirmed Nhan is NOT a werewolf.
Seer.verdict_notes: The Seer claimed their role and provided the investigation result in the same opening statement.

Guard.directive_rationale: The default priority must be the Seer; losing the Seer on Night 1 stripped the village of its factual baseline
Guard.verdict_notes: The Guard protected themselves instead of the Seer (Hoang) on Night 1.

Guard.directive_rationale: coordinate with the Guard to ensure the Seer is the primary target for protection
Guard.verdict_notes: There is no record of private coordination or communication between the Guard and the Witch.

Witch.directive_rationale: you must coordinate with the Guard to ensure the Seer is the primary target for protection
Witch.verdict_notes: There is no record of private coordination or communication between the Witch and the Guard.

Villager.directive_rationale: Never vote based on someone's 'hesitation' to join a Power Core if no factual Seer data exists yet
Villager.verdict_notes: Seer data was provided by Hoang at the very start of the Round 1 debate, so the trigger condition 'seer_data_not_yet_exists' was not met during the voting phase.

Villager.directive_rationale: In the bidding phase, ensure the Power Core speaks first to set the narrative
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Nam and Jin (Villagers) did not speak first; Hoang (Seer), Nhan (Guard), and Cong (Witch) spoke first to establish the Power Core.
Villager.verdict_notes: The Villagers allowed the Power Core roles to speak first and set the narrative.

Villager.directive_rationale: leave space for the 'silent' players to provide a factual baseline before jumping to an exile
Villager.actual_player_behavior: The Villagers (Nam, Jin) spoke, but the group moved to exile Cong very quickly after the initial claims, before all players had a chance to provide a baseline (Riley and Meg only spoke during the voting phase).
Villager.verdict_notes: The village jumped to the exile of Cong immediately after the debate started, without ensuring all silent players provided a baseline first.
